steps.instruction: Cut your pork belly into 3/4-inch thick pieces. Add them to a medium pot and cover with water. Bring the water to a boil, and boil for about 1 minute, or just until the pork turns opaque. This removes impurities and starts the cooking process. Take the pork out of the pot, rinse, and set it aside. Discard the water and clean out your pot.
Over low heat, add the oil and sugar to your wok or pot. Melt the sugar, and add the pork. Raise the heat to medium, and cook until the pork is lightly browned.
Reduce the heat to low, and add the wine. Cook for 2 minutes, then add the soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and water.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for about 45 minutes to 1 hour, until pork is fork tender. Every 5-10 minutes, stir to prevent burning and add more water if it gets too dry.
Once the pork is fork tender, if there is still a lot of visible liquid, uncover the wok, turn up the heat, and stir continuously until the sauce has reduced to a glistening coating.

tips: Braised pork belly is an every-once-in-a-while indulgence in our household. As we creep towards middle age, Bill and I try to be healthier and avoid eating too much meat.

sources.rawExcerpt:
菜名：红烧肉
简介：Shanghai-Style Braised Pork Belly (hong shao rou, 红烧肉) is a very famous dish in China. Everyone knows hong shao rou (red cooked pork) is a Shanghai favorite.
原料：1 1/2 pounds lean, skin-on pork belly；2 tablespoons oil ((any neutral oil, such as canola, vegetable, or avocado oil))；2 tablespoons rock sugar ((or granulated sugar))；1/3 cup Shaoxing wine；2 tablespoons soy sauce；1 tablespoon dark soy sauce；2-3 cups water ((see note))
步骤：1. Cut your pork belly into 3/4-inch thick pieces. Add them to a medium pot and cover with water. Bring the water to a boil, and boil for about 1 minute, or just until the pork turns opaque. This removes impurities and starts the cooking process. Take the pork out of the pot, rinse, and set it aside. Discard the water and clean out your pot. 2. Over low heat, add the oil and sugar to your wok or pot. Melt the sugar, and add the pork. Raise the heat to medium, and cook until the pork is lightly browned. 3. Reduce the heat to low, and add the wine. Cook for 2 minutes, then add the soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and water. 4. Cover and simmer over medium heat for about 45 minutes to 1 hour, until pork is fork tender. Every 5-10 minutes, stir to prevent burning and add more water if it gets too dry. 5. Once the pork is fork tender, if there is still a lot of visible liquid, uncover the wok, turn up the heat, and stir continuously until the sauce has reduced to a glistening coating.
技法：准备：15分钟；烹饪：60分钟；总用时：75分钟
提示：Braised pork belly is an every-once-in-a-while indulgence in our household. As we creep towards middle age, Bill and I try to be healthier and avoid eating too much meat.；Looking for more authentic recipes? 菜名：红烧肉
1. 选择肥瘦相间的带皮五花肉，洗净控干，切成小块。
2. 不放油，将肉块平铺在锅中，逐面煎至四面金黄并煎出油脂，盛出。【小火】
3. 保留锅内油，放入冰糖反复炒至微红，把煎好的五花肉倒回翻炒；放姜片、八角、香叶和可选干辣椒继续翻炒，加入花雕酒去腥提鲜。【小火】
4. 加入生抽和老抽调味上色，不另加盐。
5. 加入没过肉的开水，盖盖小火慢炖40至60分钟。（40-60分钟）【小火】
6. 最后大火翻拌收汁，保留浓稠挂汁，不要炒干。【大火】
7. 装盘食用。

ragEvidence 来自 recipe_entity_id 限定的 voyage-4 semantic retrieval，并覆盖 The Woks of Life 与豆果美食。
The Woks of Life 现页和既有 RAG 文档 b942e03a-0c79-4c86-97e5-4d4b2b674080 的核心原料与五段步骤一致；可复用原文内容哈希及已有向量，待 Supabase 恢复后核验文档仍存在。
豆果 3067833 的原料表当前写五花肉 800 克、冰糖 8–10 颗、姜片 2–3 片、干辣椒 2 个和桂皮小块；旧 RAG 摘录写一斤半、十来粒、姜片 4 片、干辣椒 1 个且未列桂皮。淘汰该不完整候选，不使用其图片或步骤，也不据旧摘录编辑。
页面和所有四张选定图片在 2026-10-05 公开访问均返回 HTTP 200，图片类型为 image/jpeg。
用户已确认仓库图片复制授权；运行时只引用本地文件路径。
singleSourceReason: 两个已启用网站均已复核。The Woks of Life 的上海式红烧肉页面明确对应红烧肉，原料与五段操作相符、工艺自洽，并有同页成品图及可准确映射到第 1、2、5 步的图片。豆果 3067833 当前页面原料表列有干辣椒和桂皮，但七段正文没有给出这两种香料的使用时机；当前食材数量也与既有 RAG 摘录不同，不能以旧摘录代替现页。按完整性和内部自洽优先的规则，豆果不列为有效候选。
selectionReason: 唯一合格来源提供五段可执行的完整做法，明确五花肉切块、焯水、低温化糖、中火煎肉、加酒和两种酱油、中火焖煮及最后收汁。成品图和三段步骤图均来自同一菜谱页面；第 3、4 步没有可靠独立配图，保留为纯文字。
